items.title: Chuck Findley interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 6, 2023
items.q: Barbra Streisand would like something different?

ctx.x: Oh yeah. You have to make them happy.
How did you learn — you just learned from experience that Quincy Jones would like this kind of thing and Barbra Streisand would like something different?

Of course. That’s from, once again, playing all different styles and listening, you have to listen. You listen to records, listen to the radio, you’ve got to listen to what’s going on. And I listened to Sweets, like I said, you know, somebody would say well I want you to play like Sweets, I want you to play like Miles. I had it in my head. It was in there. All the motors were in there that had all that information in the computer you know? It was all in here. And I just had to pull it out and say okay, I know…
